text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hic... Ugh. Uuuughhh~...!
I'm sorry, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...! But.
There was so much I was able to learn...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about running frantically,
but racing using your head more...
I learned that by watching Sei-chan's back!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why... so I can catch up to her back.
I'm going to get stronger and stronger!!

—Overcoming the battle against Seiun Sky,
Special Week had grown tremendously.
